- `DIALOG_GCD_ACTIVE_ITERATIONS` 395 → 394.

- Added a `DIALOG_TAIL_NONCE` island selector: a fixed-length 96-op block of identity `X;X` pairs appended at the very end of the stream. Each of 48 bits steers one pair at `target_x[0]` or `target_x[1]`, so the op count and circuit action stay byte-stable and only the SHAKE256-derived Fiat-Shamir test support moves. Set to `296434`.

This submission ports the public TrailMix shrunken-PZ point-add circuit into the ecdsa.fail `src/point_add` interface. The bridge keeps the challenge register order (`target_x`, `target_y`, `offset_x`, `offset_y`) and maps the TrailMix reversible operation stream into the native ecdsa.fail operation model without changing the trusted evaluator.
